Created page with "Coast to Coast AM is an American late-night radio talk show that delves into topics such as the paranormal, conspiracy theories, and fringe science. Created by [[Art Bell]] in 1988, the program gained a massive following, airing on over 600 affiliates and becoming one of the most popular overnight shows in the country. After Bell's retirement, [[George Noory]] took over as the primary host."
